files.description: Persist measurements first; render their presentation independently of the browser.
Probe encoder capabilities once in the long-lived app worker.
Reuse loaded media code in the normal app worker; never reuse fitted results.
Save a separate, contact-anchored source clip for later swing timing.
Keep estimator imports warm in the app's internal Python worker.
Share frame-accurate source preparation between rendering and final save.
Internal EV processor. Communicates over stdio; opens no network listener.
Run direct-video prediction under controlled evidence ablations.
Sample input sensitivity separately from nominal flight acceptance.
Append higher-EV long-field synthetic trajectories to the SQLite database.
Append lower-EV small-field synthetic trajectories to the SQLite database.
Propose early ball observations from video using simple motion tracking.
Baseball Flight Sim compatible trajectory generation.
Build a compact prediction summary JSON for the local annotation app.
Estimate a ground-plane field homography from annotated landmarks.
Camera calibration and exact local perspective derivatives.
Register ball marks using background evidence, never a proposed ball flight.
Simple camera projection for synthetic baseball trajectories.
Render an export clip with title cards and an annotated estimate banner.
Compare observations using a landmark-derived ground-plane homography.
Compare a real observation package against synthetic trajectories.
Score observed ball points against stored projected synthetic observations.
Separate measured frame positions from an event occurring between frames.
Detect a likely bat-contact time from the video's audio transient.
Direct video-first LA estimate, then EV from flight table constraints.
Fit measured carry and flight time; camera projection is diagnostic only.
Review evidence; alternatives never replace the user's observations.
Bounded, process-local reuse of unchanged evidence analysis, never labels.
Suggest reviewable field landmarks from a single video frame.
Small, process-local cache of fits from unchanged measured evidence.
The existing fixed-step flight equations, optionally compiled without fastmath.
Rotate a calibrated video flight into an equal-scale launch-angle side view.
Generate synthetic image observations through a rough camera prior.
Generate Baseball Flight Sim-compatible synthetic trajectory data.
Speed evidence from relative, camera-corrected late vertical motion.
Late marks constrain WHEN the image trajectory turns, never absolute height.
Load generated synthetic CSV files into a local SQLite database.
Match observed ball points to synthetic trajectories across camera/vantage hypotheses.
Conservative consistency checks against user-marked early flight anchors.
Cooperative cancellation, shared across hot-reloaded estimator modules.
Build and validate a replacement database without touching the active file.
Fill gaps between stored trajectories using the existing flight model.
Save a tagged hit package, prediction result, and optional contact clip to SQLite.
Early spatial launch geometry; later turn timing, never absolute late height.
Track batted-ball flight as a whole trajectory, not per-frame detections.
Uniform flight generation using a batched version of baseball_flight's equations.
Read-only, short-batch image tracker. No EV model, saved fit, or database inputs.
Read the same JPEG pixels from a file or a decoder pipe.
Overlap native launch verification with the remaining video decode.
